mainEntity.name: How do I determine if my property is suitable for a side home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: To determine suitability for a side home addition, assess your property's available space and local zoning regulations. Key factors include setback requirements, which dictate how close you can build to property lines, and maximum lot coverage limits. A professional site survey can precisely map your property boundaries and existing structures. Additionally, consider the impact on natural light for existing rooms and neighboring properties. Hometelligent Inc. can assist with an initial site assessment to evaluate these considerations before detailed design work begins.
